contract.purpose: Meme Lab helps people selecting reactions for everyday conversations find a fitting meme through a corrected catalogue and contextual AI ranking.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Turn one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately.
contract.driftNote: Purpose fields match PRODUCT.md. Anna Store version metadata is operational status and does not change the purpose contract; do not publish a lifecycle claim in the redesigned entry.

contract.thesis: Studio: quiet compact controls with equal full-meme canvases, restrained navy/white/cobalt identity.
